value.rationale: The least block length at which a coarse Lee enumerator ceases to determine dual Lee enumeration for the rank-two class is a motivated natural boundary to broad nonduality theorems. A complete all-code finite cutoff plus direct seven-coordinate witness is a meaningful shortest-obstruction classification; not an arbitrary chosen parameter slice or a coding-rate improvement.
